description: Iowa Attorney General Brenna Bird and Consumer Protection Investigator Al Perales appeared at the Exira Event Center on Thursday afternoon for a public presentation on fraud and scams targeting Iowans. The program covered common fraud schemes, ways consumers can protect themselves and their personal information, and steps to take if they believe they have been the victim of a scam.…
